text:
ana: Quick question from the all-hands Q&A: what's the exact canary plan for the EMEA GPU rollout? I need the steps so I can sync docs and customer comms.

tom: High level: 1) provisioned hosts -> 2) rack & network -> 3) internal perf canary (staging) -> 4) gated soft launch to 10% of hosted traffic -> 5) expand to 50% -> GA. Each stage has go/no-go gates.

ana: typo — ana :)

tom: oops — thanks!

kay: Where do we define the canary traffic split and rollback triggers? Product wants to control thresholds.

owen: We'll use the rollout service config. Example policy snippet we showed in the demo: 
```json
{
  "rollout": "canary",
  "stages": [
    {"name":"internal","duration":"48h","traffic":1},
    {"name":"soft_launch","duration":"72h","traffic":10},
    {"name":"broaden","duration":"7d","traffic":50}
  ],
  "metrics": {
    "p99_latency_ms": 350,
    "error_rate_pct": 0.5
  },
  "auto_rollback": true
}
```
This ties to our tracing and SLO alerts.

ana: (still me) — will the canary use the regional KV-cache or a read-only replica? Concerned about cache warming and cold-start latency.

own: We'll route canary to the regional caches for EMEA. For cross-region fallbacks we'll use a read-replica mode to avoid write amplification. Cache warmers will pre-populate hot prefixes during the soft launch window.

rachel: Billing note: any "free burst" minutes during canary should not be promised to customers. If we offer temporary bursts for stability we need clear language. I'll draft a short FAQ blurb and send to kay + tom.

kay: Thanks — product will want a line for the public status page.

ana: Ops question: are we planning scheduled maintenance windows during ramp? Need to communicate to Dedicated customers.

tom: We'll avoid planned maintenance during the 72h soft launch window unless critical. Scheduled maintenance will be outside the ramp; customers on Dedicated get a 72h advance notice per SLA.

owen: SRE blockers: need to validate cross-region cache eviction behavior and ensure session affinity survives fallback. I'll run a focused chaos experiment Wed night and report results in this thread.

deploy-bot: rollout/emea-canary created at 1735000100 — status: queued :rocket:

ana: Action items? I'll compile and put into the public-facing comms doc (short FAQ + timeline).

tom: Owners: tom (infra) validate rack->staging timeline by Mon; owen (SRE) run cache chaos Wed; rachel (billing) draft burst/cost FAQ by Thu; kay (product) prepare status page copy.

kay: Also want a one-paragraph summary for the blog that marketing can reuse. I'll loop in marketing.

ana: perfect — please ping me when the FAQ is ready and I'll publish.

rachel: I'll link the billing draft to the rollout doc when ready: https://go/redwood/emea-billing-draft (internal).

owen: Starting chaos tests Wed 22:00 UTC, will include failure modes: node loss, cache poison, cross-region ACL flaps.

ana: great, thanks everyone. Leaving thread open for any post-call notes.
